provenance: M41, the second of the two small-value probe tasks the M41 block names verbatim. Same element and same answer string as `sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status`; what this case adds is the TASK TEXT. `How many items are extracted?` is a counting question, and two guards read task text and could refuse it: `verifier.is_aggregate` (ADR-018's plan lint — a superlative ask must read the page once with `extract_all`) and the resolver's `_PLURAL_ASK` narrowing refusal (ADR-026/D29). Neither fires here — `_AGGREGATE` wants `(which|what|who) … (most|least|highest|…)` and this phrasing has neither half, and the target resolves uniquely so no narrowing rung is reached — so the count is answered from the same named status line. Ground truth `counts.extracted = 18` from the inspector's `/api/extract/fixture`, re-verified 2026-08-26 against `git_sha` `5a44758598f5`. Watched RED first with `expect.answer` set to the bare string `18`: `answer_matches: false`, reason `answer 'doc_status: success\n— 18 extracted · 5 incorporated_by_reference\nfixture: aapl-2025' != expected '18'` — which is also the honest limitation this case publishes: the agent returns the whole status line, not the isolated count.
